label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: O cuando tocare en impureza de adam, a toda su impureza que se impure en ella, y se ocultare desde él, y él conociere, y culpado.
spanish: O cuando tocare en impureza de hombre, a toda su impureza que se impure en ella, y se ocultare desde nosotros, y él conociere, y será culpable.
grammarChanges: אָדָם (H120, common noun absolute) was left untranslated as 'adam'; replaced with 'hombre'.
מִמֶּנּוּ (H4480, suffix 1st common plural per morph tag) was rendered 'desde él' (3ms); corrected to 'desde nosotros' to match the tagged suffix person/number.

ואָשֵׁם (H816, qal sequential perfect 3ms) was rendered as the bare form 'culpado', which reads as a passive participle and drops the finite verb; replaced with the finite verb form 'será culpable' to keep the qal stative force and the sequential-perfect (future) sense.
